tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Current price of one or more coins. Example: ids ["bitcoin","ethereum"], currency "eur".

tools.name: list_coins
tools.description: Coins ranked by 24h volume, or matching a search. Example: query "sol", limit 5.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Candles for one coin. Example: id "bitcoin", interval "1d", limit 30. Needs an API key. (Add an API key to use it: https://coinprice.dev/signup)

tools.name: get_markets
tools.description: Futures markets (price, funding, open interest) or crypto prediction markets (odds). Example: type "predictions", coin "bitcoin". Needs an API key. (Add an API key to use it: https://coinprice.dev/signup)

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the API documentation. Example: query "rate limit".
